name: Filler: why I wouldn't use it here (approved)
description: The carousel Nafisa approved on 5 Oct 2026, word for word, except one change: the em dash on slide 7 is now a comma, because the brand rules block em dashes. Add the photos on slides 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7.
title: I wouldn't use filler here

slides.body: Many patients come in thinking they need filler when their face starts to look…

slides.headline: WHY?
slides.body: Because if the real problem is skin laxity or collagen loss, adding more filler can actually make the face look *heavier.* *Not younger.*

slides.headline: THEN I CREATE A PLAN THAT TARGETS *THE CAUSE*, NOT JUST THE SYMPTOM.
slides.body:
Sometimes that's filler.
Sometimes it's not.
It depends on *you, your face* and *your goals*.

slides.headline: TREATMENTS I OFTEN USE INSTEAD (OR IN COMBINATION)
_Good aesthetics isn't about_ *adding more.*
slides.body: It's about choosing what's right for you, and knowing what *not* to do.

slides.headline: Curious what I'd recommend for *you?*
slides.body: Book a consultation and let's create a plan that's right for your face, your goals and *you.*
